rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a pastime or rules-based game, including a game title or general video game.

example.english: Let's play a game after dinner.
example.traditional: 我哋食完飯玩吓遊戲先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 waan2 haa5 jau4 hei3 sin1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a video or computer game rather than a game in general.

example.english: This video game is really fun to play.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 din6 zi2 jau4 hei3 hou2 noi6 waan2

rows.note: Use 局 for a particular round or game, especially the technical game segment in racket sports.

example.english: You served really well in this game.
example.jyutping: ni1 guk6 nei5 faat3 kau4 faat3 dak1 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when game means someone's level, ability, or mastery rather than the activity itself.

example.english: You can tell from watching him play that his game is really strong.
example.traditional: 睇吓佢打波就知佢實力幾勁。
example.jyutping: tai2 haa5 keoi5 daa2 bo1 zau6 zi1 keoi5 sat6 lik6 gei2 ging6
